notes.title: The Bloom and Gloom Update is finally here
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your patience villagers. We know it’s been a while since the last update, but we’ve been working tirelessly behind the scenes to bring this one to life. First off, a huge shoutout to everyone who shared their feedback. Your voices have been absolutely instrumental in shaping Castle of Blackwater, and we truly wouldn’t be here without you. Now, we’re beyond excited for you to dive into this update. It’s packed with long-awaited improvements… and yes, it looks absolutely stunning.

[b][h1]New Gameplay Trailer✨[/h1][/b] 
[previewyoutube=-_1fgb0v_wo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h1]📜RELEASE NOTES 2.0.1📜[/h1][/b]
[b][h2]Map & Environment Overhaul[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] New dynamic and interactive lighting system added in the waiting lobby, castle and safe zone.
[*] Castle map has been resized for better player interaction and fewer dead zones.
[*] Safe zone reduced in size and redesigned for clearer movement flow.
[*] Door teleporters have been replaced with magical mirrors for a more immersive fantasy feel.
[*] Some task locations have been rearranged to improve gameplay flow and balance.
[*] Dragon lobby interaction: In the waiting area, you can now toss meat to the dragon to avoid getting scorched. Feed it or face the flames!
[/list]
[b][h2]Faction & Gameplay Balancing⚖️[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Forgotten faction can now win independently of other factions.
[*] Forgotten players (like the Werewolf) are now true solo roles. They can no longer "collude" easily with other factions for shared victories.
[*] Werewolf role made slightly harder, but more rewarding as a solo winner.
[/list]
[b][h2]Safe Zone Mechanics Update[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] New cost mechanic introduced for entering the safe zone. First night is free, increases with 1 soul per night.
[*] Encourages risk-taking and castle exploration at night.
[*] Aims to balance safe zone vs. castle dynamics for all factions.
[/list]
[b][h2]Clarity & Visual Improvements🧠 [/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Improved visual clarity of abilities for better in-game understanding. Reworked animations for the Vigilante, Knight and Mentalist.
[*] Easier to see when and how abilities are used. Focus on making gameplay more intuitive without relying solely on tutorials.
[/list]
[h2][b]Character Ability Reworks[/b][/h2]
[b]Lumberjack's Active Ability[/b]
[list]
[*] Instantly could complete any active task every cycle. (often used for self-confirmation at start game)
[*] New Ability: Collect bonus XP by completing tasks. Once per game, can claim saved XP. The longer he waits, the higher the reward but riskier.
[/list]

[b]Record Keeper Active Ability Rework:[/b]
[list]
[*] Can no longer share free speech (used for easy self-confirmation).
[*] Now visually shares suspicion about one player's faction.
[/list]
[b]Passive Ability Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Now shares a copy of the Challenger Log, increasing the importance of accurate record-keeping.
[/list]
[h2][b]Performance & Stability🛠️ [/b][/h2]
Major improvements in:
[list]
[*] Game stability
[*] Visual polish
[*] Core balance tweaks for smoother overall gameplay
[/list]

notes.title: Castle of Blackwater Release Notes 1.1.10
notes.notes:
🚨 This is a [b]BIG[/b] one! 🚨

We’ve just pushed one of the most impactful updates to Castle of Blackwater of the year so far — and we’re excited to share it with you. Over the past few weeks, we’ve been deep in the code, refactoring and simplifying core systems to boost stability, reduce load times, and pave the way for big future updates.

But that’s not all... This build also includes major game design changes that will seriously shift how your matches play out. So grab a cup of something magical, read the patch notes carefully, and prepare yourself for a whole new layer of strategic chaos!

As always, thank you for being part of this journey. We're committed to making Castle of Blackwater better every single day. 🏰 

Let’s dive in:
[h2]🛠️ Game Development[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]🆕 Zoom Feature! [/b]– When standing still for a while, your camera will now zoom in slightly, adding tension and cinematic flair to quiet moments. 👁️
[*] [b]🧩 Deadly Duel Rework[/b] – The duel now selects a random minigame instead of always the same one! We’ve also added fresh victory/defeat UI to make it more epic.
[*] [b]Sheriff Feedback[/b] – If the Sheriff searches and fails to find a body, a distinct fail sound will now play to clarify the outcome.
[*] [b]Ghost Dagger Cooldown[/b] (Protector Only) – Ghost daggers now have a cooldown after hitting for Protectors. Satanic ghosts remain unpunished... for now.
[*] [b]Werewolf Win Condition Update[/b] – The Werewolf no longer needs to kill both a Protector and a Satanic — they just need to rack up enough kills. Bloodthirst rewarded. 🐺
[*] [b]Protector Win Condition Tweak[/b] – Protectors can now only win by voting out or eliminating both the Satanic AND the Werewolf in any way, or by finishing the XP of course.
[*] [b]Removed Satanic Kill Sharing[/b] – We've removed the concept of Satanic players needing to share kills in fewer-player lobbies. 
[*] [b]Changed Faction Distribution per Lobby Size [/b]– We've reconfigured the faction distribution logic to line up with all the above faction balancing changes.
[*] [b]Enabled 5 and 6 Player Lobbies [/b]– Thanks to all these changes, it is now possible to start playing a game with a minimum of 5 players instead of 7. (More changes coming to improve this experience)
[*] [b]Dead Shop Inventory Sharing[/b] – Powerup inventory is now shared by faction, meaning if you drain the shop’s stock, your dead teammates are out of luck!
[*] [b]Ambient Sound System Added[/b] – You’ll now hear random atmospheric sounds to deepen immersion and make the castle feel more alive (or haunted). 👻
[*] [b]💀 “Final Word” Powerup Reworked![/b] – Say goodbye to the old, dead ghost voting power. Introducing Ethereal Endorsement: Dead players can now choose one living player to receive a double vote in the next voting round. Political hauntings, anyone?
[/list]
[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the voting timer disappeared for some players.
[*] Fixed broken or disappearing death animations.
[*] Fixed players being able to select the same base color skin (no more clones!).
[*] Rebuilt the entire time system, resolving several major issues like random teleports and vote round glitches.
[*] Fixed player volume settings that were not saving correctly when the UI was closed.
[*] Fixed ghost daggers not being pick-up-able after being thrown.
[*] Implemented fixes that may prevent the black screen loop bug some players experienced after games.
[*] Additional sound system fixes for more consistent and immersive audio.
[/list]
[h2]🔧 Work In Progress[/h2]
We're actively working on:
[list]
[*] Streamlining asset pixel density (PPU) to prepare for mobile porting 📱
[*] Dramatic lighting system to add a whole new visual mood layer 🔦
[*] Ability reworks to improve balance, clarity, and fun ⚡
[*] Smaller map variant focused on tighter foot traffic and faster games 🗺️
[/list]
Grab your friends, hop into a lobby, and come try out everything new in 1.1.10. We’ll see you in the castle. And as always… 

Stay spooky!!! 👻

notes.title: Castle of Blackwater v1.1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Another week, another update! 👻🛠️

This one's a smaller patch focused on smoothing out some rough edges and giving the Silencer a little extra… bite. Thanks again to everyone who's been sharing bugs, feedback, and suggestions in Discord — it's been super helpful as we continue fine-tuning the game post-launch.

Let’s take a look at what’s new in v1.1.4:

[h3]🛠️ Game Development[/h3]
[list]

[/list]
[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ghost Dagger Smoothness – Ghost daggers now fly more smoothly and reliably when fired. No more phantom misfires!
[*] Settings Panel Fix – Player audio settings will now properly save when you close the panel.
[*] Voting Results Display – The voting log now correctly displays who voted for whom after each round.
[*] Tutorial Fixes (Again!) – We’ve patched more bugs that were breaking the tutorial or leaving players stuck. Thanks to those who reported them!
[/list]
[h3]🚧 Known Issues (Still Being Worked On)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lobby Host Disconnecting – If the host leaves during a match, it still causes the rest of the lobby to be booted. We're actively working on a fix, but it’s tied to our recent networking upgrade to Fusion 2, which adds some complexity.
[*] Voting Timer Bug – Some players don’t see the countdown timer during voting rounds. We’re aware and have a fix in the pipeline.
[/list]
Thanks again for your patience, feedback, and all the fun chaos in the castle. More improvements are coming soon — stay tuned! 🏰💀

notes.title: Castle of Blackwater v1.1.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Over the past few weeks, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, making Castle of Blackwater a smoother, more intuitive, and more stable experience for everyone, especially for first-time players stepping into the castle for the very first time. 

From quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes to polish passes and UX upgrades, this update is all about boosting clarity and stability without compromising on the charm and chaos you know and love. We’ve also focused on continuing to improve the experience for our returning players with a mix of requested tweaks, fixes, and behind-the-scenes tuning. :flip: 

Chatting with so many of you in Discord has been awesome. Your feedback, bug reports, and spicy hot takes have been a huge help. We hope you spot your suggestions and ideas in this update, and if not, don’t worry; there’s more coming. 

Without further ado, here’s what’s new in Build 1.1.0 🏰👇

[h3]🛠️ Game Development[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Upgraded Unity Engine[/b] – We’ve upgraded our Unity version to improve overall stability and reduce random crashes. This also unlocks exciting new tech we’re looking forward to experimenting with soon.
[*] [b]Upgraded Photon Networking[/b] – Our new Photon version comes with better networking performance and lays the groundwork for potential reconnect features in the future.
[*] [b]Refactored Sound System[/b] – We overhauled our sound system for better consistency, performance, and creative flexibility in future sound design.
[*] [b]Temporary Character Size Increase[/b] – Characters are now 20% larger, making it easier to traverse the map and show off your latest cosmetic drip.
[*] [b]Safe Zone Minigame Fix[/b] – The Safe Zone pop-up no longer interrupts active minigames.
[*] [b]Visible In-Game Lobbies[/b] – Players can now see lobbies that are currently in progress to decide whether to wait or search for another.
[*] [b]Body Report Sound[/b] – A new global bell sound plays when a body is reported, slightly buffing the Sheriff and turning up the tension.
[*] [b]Player Audio Settings[/b] – New settings UI allows players to individually mute or adjust the volume of other players.
[*] [b]Ghost Projectile Diminishing Returns[/b] – Getting hit by multiple ghost daggers now has diminishing effects, reducing the chance of spam kills.
[*] [b]Werewolf Sound Fix[/b] – Players in the Safe Zone will no longer hear the werewolf howl when a transformation occurs.
[*] [b]Push-to-Talk Added[/b] – Now available in the settings for those who prefer more controlled voice chat.
[*] [b]Musical Flames Rework[/b] – Slightly simplified and sped up: one fewer step and faster timing.
[*] [b]Voting Round Duration Increased[/b] – Discussion time increased from 45s → 60s and defense time from 10s → 12s.
[*] [b]Ghost Soul Economy Rebalancing[/b] – Reduced ghost soul spawn rate and increased prices for some ghost powerups to tighten the late-game loop.
[/list]
[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Vigilante Blood Effect[/b] – Vigilantes now get blood on their hands after a successful kill.
[*] [b]Ability Use Bugs Fixed[/b] – Fixed several bugs where player abilities couldn’t be used in specific areas.
[*] [b]Sound Glitches Resolved[/b] – A broad sweep of sound-related bugs has been resolved for cleaner, more immersive audio.
[*] [b]Tutorial Stability Pass[/b] – Fixed multiple issues that could cause the tutorial to break or leave players stuck.
[*] [b]Ghost Dagger Debuff Timing[/b] – Fixed a bug where the confusion effect lingered too long after being hit by ghost daggers.
[*] [b]Room Names on Mini-map[/b] – Fixed display issues where room names weren’t appearing on the mini-map.
[*] [b]Disconnected Bodies Reporting[/b] – Dead bodies from disconnected players can now be reported correctly.
[*] [b]Book of Tasks Exploit[/b] – Patched an exploit allowing players to open the Book of Tasks just before teleporting after a vote.
[*] [b]Psychic Ability Safe Zone Bug[/b] – Psychic ability now properly renders the correct map, even when used in the safe zone.
[*] [b]Localization Fixes[/b] – Numerous language/localization issues across different UIs have been corrected.
[*] [b]Record Keeper Note Bug[/b] – Fixed an issue where the death note would appear multiple times.
[*] [b]Outfit Save Issue[/b] – Fixed a bug that prevented players from saving new outfits in the lobby inventory screen.
[*] [b]Rematch Lobby Fix[/b] – Public games now correctly stay public after a rematch.
[*] [b]Dead Ghost UI Bug[/b] – Ghosts can now properly interact with all components in the player list UI.
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
Just a quick heads-up: a few issues remain to be fixed. We didn't want these to prevent us from uploading before the weekend, but keep this in mind and don't worry about reporting these known issues:

[list]
[*] If the host player (the one who started the lobby) disconnects from an active game, the whole game will crash for everyone left in it. (this is a complex networking issue that we'll fix next week)
[*] Sometimes, some players won't see the time in the voting round
[*] The ghostly dagger, although better than yesterday, isn't as smooth as we want it to
[*] The player menu in the settings panel doesn't save your preferences when you close it.
[/list]
If you find any other issues than the above, please let us know!!

[h3]👀 What’s Next?[/h3]
As always, while we’ve squashed a lot of bugs and made big improvements in this patch, we know the work isn’t done. Our next area of focus revolves around making a new smaller map, implementing a cool new system for environmental lighting, and making a lot of improvements to mechanics and abilities to increase their clarity in gameplay. After that's completed, we'll move on to the next phase, which will include host settings, new characters, and more retention systems 🙂 

Thanks for being part of the journey and helping us shape Castle of Blackwater into the best version it can be. 

We’ll see you in the castle! 👻

notes.title: Castle of Blackwater Hotfix - v1.0.6
notes.notes:
Hello villagers! 

We've been blown away by your response and enthusiasm. We're dedicated to quickly addressing your feedback and ensuring everyone has a smooth and enjoyable experience in the castle. 

Thank you for your patience and reports as we work to swiftly squash bugs and implement improvements!

[h3]Hotfixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Ghostly Footsteps Silenced[/b] – Ghost players will no longer incorrectly hear footsteps from the living, improving immersion.
[*] [b]Lobby Code Copying Fix[/b] – Fixed the issue causing copied lobby codes to show up incorrectly as "***".
[*] Fixed Vigilante kills not showing as blood on hands from the Mentalist ability.
[*] [b]Satanic Chat Notifications[/b] – Satanic chat now correctly displays notifications, making it easier to communicate secretly with teammates.
[*] [b]Disconnected Stability Improvements[/b] – Fixed critical issues causing the game to break when players disconnected unexpectedly.
[*] [b]Role Reveal Screen Bug[/b] – Addressed an issue causing the game to occasionally freeze at the role reveal screen.
[*] [b]Public Lobby Rematch Fix[/b] – Public lobbies will now correctly remain public when rematching after a game ends.
[*] Cosmetic store animations are looping incorrectly.
[*] Various UI and visual glitches in the cosmetics and inventory screens.
[*] Items purchased sometimes not appearing immediately in inventory.
[*] Persistent Phantom UI icons on the home screen.
[*] Book stacking is more stable and less volatile
[*] Fixes to the FTUE to prevent players from getting stuck.
[*] Fixed mentalist ability sometimes targeting dead ghosts
[*] We temporarily removed "Confusion" and "Message from the Dead" from the Dead Ghost Powerup Shop for rebalancing.
[/list]
[h3]Keep Your Feedback Coming[/h3]
We greatly appreciate your reports and are actively monitoring our Discord channels. Please continue sharing any issues you encounter or suggestions you have. Your feedback is essential as we strive to perfect Castle of Blackwater!

Thanks again for your incredible support and patience. We'll keep rolling out patches and improvements as quickly as possible. Join our Discord community and come play with us!

See you in the Castle! 🏰

notes.title: Castle of Blackwater 0.10.30 Release Notes
notes.notes:
This moment is the culmination of 3 years of hard work, passion, and dedication from our incredible development team. Huge thanks and applause to everyone involved, you're the reason this game shines! We are confident you'll enjoy a polished, stable, and thrilling player experience, and we're excited to grow and improve the game alongside our amazing community. 🫂

[h3] 🛠️ Game Development[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Sprint & Stamina: [/b]Players can now sprint by pressing the left-shift button (customizable). Stamina regenerates when resting; fully depleted stamina triggers delayed regeneration.  
[*] [b]Ghostly Daggers:[/b] Ghost players can now shoot ghostly daggers at fellow ghosts, causing temporary confusion effects.  
[*] [b]Lobby-specific Balancing:[/b] Game balancing is now adjusted for lobby size, ensuring smoother gameplay regardless of party size.  
[*] [b]Cosmetics Store:[/b] Express your style with our newly designed in-game cosmetics store! Cosmetics come in various rarities and can be acquired using Gold or Glyphs—earned through gameplay or purchasable in-store.  
[*][b]Polished Animations & Performance:[/b] Character animations have been enhanced, player movement predictions improved, and Sync support added, resulting in smoother, crisper visuals.  
[*] [b]Exciting New Cosmetics:[/b] Show off with brand-new cosmetic collections, including 11 unique animals, plus Ninja, Samurai, and Plague Doctor outfits.  
[*] [b]Stylish Death Animations:[/b] Leave the vote with flair using new voted-out animations.  
[*] [b]Minigame Hints:[/b] Added helpful hints to every minigame, ensuring quicker understanding and maximum fun.  
[*] [b]End-of-Game Rewards:[/b] Celebrate each match with new animations as you collect XP and Gold.  
[*] [b]Finalized Leveling System:[/b] Level up to earn rewards, such as Gold and Glyphs, enhancing your progression and gameplay experience.  
[*] [b]Private Lobby Enhancements:[/b] Lobby codes are now hidden during private matches for smoother streaming and privacy.  
[*] [b]Satanic Teammate Indicator:[/b] Satanic players now have their names highlighted in red, making teammate identification clearer than ever.  
[*] [b]Post-vote Teleport:[/b] Players will be teleported to random locations after voting, adding excitement and unpredictability to the gameplay.  
[*] [b]Quick Task Changes:[/b] Players now receive a random task (easy, medium, or hard) instead of just an easy task.  
[/list]
[h3] 🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized and streamlined game launch sequence for faster loading and fewer errors.  
[*] Corrected numerous localization errors.  
[*] Fixed cosmetics loading bugs.  
[*] Addressed player collider issues preventing unintended map glitches.  
[*] Minigames are now properly reset, resolving related gameplay issues.  
[*] Resolved login failure bugs.  
[*] Dead disconnected players can now be reported properly.  
[*] Fixed minimap display bugs.  
[*] Addressed freeze issues when minigames intersected with safe zone pop-ups.  
[*] Corrected voting round spawning glitches to avoid overlapping players.  
[/list]
[h3]📜 Final Note  [/h3]
While we've put immense effort into ensuring a polished and bug-free launch, new issues may surface as we welcome more adventurers into the Castle. Rest assured, our team remains active and responsive in Discord, eager to tackle any issues and enhance your experience further. Thank you for your incredible support—we can't wait to see you in-game!

notes.title: Castle of Blackwater 0.10.5 Release Notes
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that our Steam Next Fest launch was a massive success! 

Castle of Blackwater is now publicly available on Steam (in demo form) for the first time since our inception, and we couldn’t be more excited! We’re incredibly proud of the progress we’ve made and the amazing community that has formed around the game. 

A huge shoutout to the dev team for going the extra mile, and working overtime to ensure the latest stability fixes made it in. And of course, a warm welcome to all new and returning players! 

[h2][b] Game Development [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Emote Syncing[/b] – Players performing the same emote near each other will now synchronize their animations and audio for a more immersive experience. Dance battles, anyone? 
[*] [b]Next Fest Moderation Tools[/b] – Players in the demo will see informative pop-ups and UI guides directing them to Discord and the game night schedule. Server access can also be toggled on and off as needed.
[*] [b]Voice Chat Reconnect[/b] – If a player’s voice chat disconnects, the system will now attempt to automatically reconnect them after a few seconds. No more ghostly silence!
[*] [b]New Emotes[/b]! – Added Magical Broom and Stargazing emotes, among others! 
[*] [b]Emote Spawnable Objects[/b] – We now support spawnable objects in emotes, meaning you can summon disco balls, instruments, and much more! 
[*] [b]New Emote Music[/b] – Almost every emote now has sound! More ways to express yourself in the game! 
[/list][list]
[*]  [b]Cancel Emote Button[/b] – Players can now cancel an emote so they’re not stuck mid-dance during the voting round.
[/list]
[h2][b] Bug Fixes [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few ability-related bugs that caused some powers to stop working.
[*] Fixed multiple player disconnect issues.
[*] Fixed a critical bug where if the host disconnected at the end of the voting round, the game would freeze.
[*] Fixed several bugs related to “Failed to BootStart” errors.
[*] Fixed a spawning orb bug where orbs wouldn’t disappear as expected.
[*] Fixed remaining voice chat issues.
[*] Fixed the 5-day win condition not triggering properly.
[*] Fixed player name length issues causing UI bugs.
[*] Resolved multiple sound issues affecting immersion.
[*] Fixed visual glitches in the Book of Tasks.
[/list]
[h2][b] Join the Organized Play Sessions! [/b][/h2]
To get the best multiplayer experience, keep an eye on the organized play sessions in our [url=https://discord.gg/castle-of-blackwater][b]Discord Community![/b][/url] These scheduled game nights maximize your chances of finding full lobbies, so don’t miss out! 

Thanks again to everyone for being part of this journey—we can’t wait to see you in-game! ✨

[url=https://discord.gg/DZAhbfnR7M][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949571/14731eb548910b20b5ee546c5e05c794803ddeae.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Castle of Blackwater 0.9.101 Release Notes
notes.notes:
The focus over the past month—and for the next one—has been stability and overall improvements to the gameplay experience. We deeply appreciate everyone who has been joining our playtest evenings, helping us test these builds, and providing valuable feedback. Your input has been essential in getting us here, and we can’t thank you enough!  

[h2]Game Development[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Localization is here![/b] Castle of Blackwater is now available in English, Turkish, Spanish, Dutch, German, French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, and Russian.  
[*] [b]Werewolf Adjustment[/b] – Prey targets no longer see the werewolf on the minimap when a soul is picked up (but can still hear him). Surviving just got a whole lot harder.  
[*] [b]Anti-Cheat Upgrades[/b] – Two non-intrusive versions of anti-cheat have been implemented to keep the gameplay fair and enjoyable for everyone.  
[*] [b]Voice Chat Overhaul[/b] – Simplified voice chat controls in the settings panel and added per-player volume controls in the right-click player options menu. Communication has never been clearer.  
[*] [b]Player Analytics[/b] – A new version of player analytics has been added to help us understand how you interact with the game and improve it even further.  
[*] [b]New Emote Sounds & Songs[/b] – Check out the latest emotes, featuring a variety of sounds and songs to enhance gameplay.  
[*] [b]Automatic Ready-Up[/b] – Players are now automatically marked as ready when moving into a newly joined lobby.  
[*] [b]Book Stack Improvements[/b] – Significant changes have been made to Book Stack, making it a much more balanced and engaging experience.  
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound manager wouldn’t destroy itself upon leaving the lobby, preventing multiple music tracks from overlapping.  
[*] Fixed various issues causing dead ghosts to get stuck or freeze in place.  
[*] Resolved a bug that prevented new players from saving their load-outs.  
[*] Fixed the recordkeeper note not displaying correctly during voting rounds.  
[*] Addressed frequent teleporting issues for dead ghosts that caused maps to fail to load.  
[*] Fixed player list breaking under specific conditions.  
[*] Locked player movement while interacting with the lobby inventory to prevent unintended glitches.  
[*] Ensured the lumberjack ability cannot be used while in a minigame.  
[*] Implemented stability fixes for player disconnects during voting rounds.  
[*] Fixed several minor broken UI elements.  
[*] Resolved an issue where long player names broke non-dynamic UI frames.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the game wouldn’t end after five turns.  
[*] Resolved an issue causing the psychic ability to trigger twice.  
[*] Fixed the "You’ve been silenced" text not disappearing after a player’s death.  
[*] Fixed a bug where winning as Werewolf was not displayed on the victory screen.  
[*] Resolved an issue where emote sounds weren’t playing in the inventory.  
[*] Fixed layering issues and improvements in various minigames.
[/list]

[h2]Work in Progress[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addressing networking-related edge cases to improve stability during laggy conditions.  
[*] Continued UI cleanup to make interfaces simpler and more efficient.  
[*] Adding custom logic to support hosting Next Fest events.  
[/list]

[h2]Next Fest is Two Weeks Away![/h2]
We’re thrilled to showcase Castle of Blackwater to a wider audience during Next Fest. This is a major milestone for our community, and we can’t wait to see you all supporting the game! A huge thank you to the entire team and our amazing players for making this possible.  

Let’s keep the momentum going and take Castle of Blackwater to new heights!
